ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read “Distribution map of seawater isotherms in a certain sea area”. <image1> The bending of the isotherms at place Jia is due to the influence of an ocean current. What kind of ocean current affects place Jia?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the values of the isotherms on the right side from top to bottom are 8℃, 10℃, 12℃, 14℃, and 16℃ in sequence, indicating that the seawater temperature above is lower and the seawater temperature below is higher. Jia is located in the upper-left part of the figure. The isotherms near Jia, compared with the overall nearly east-west trend, bend upward, protruding toward the low-temperature side. Then reason: When judging the nature of an ocean current, the rule can be used: “If an isotherm protrudes toward the low-temperature direction, it indicates that higher-temperature seawater extends into a low-temperature area, and it is a warm current; if it protrudes toward the high-temperature direction, it is a cold current.” The isotherms at Jia protrude toward the upper low-temperature area; therefore, Jia is affected by a warm current.

method.method_draft: 描述图像中的温度递变和甲处弯曲方向：上方为低温区、下方为高温区，甲处等温线向上方低温区凸出。根据“等温线向低温方向凸出为暖流”的规则，判断甲处受暖流影响。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中右侧等温线数值从上到下依次为8℃、10℃、12℃、14℃、16℃，说明上方海水温度较低、下方海水温度较高。甲位于图左上部，甲处附近的等温线相对整体近东西向的走向向上方弯曲，凸向低温一侧。再推理：判断洋流性质时，可用规则“等温线向低温方向凸出，表示有较高温海水伸入低温区，为暖流；向高温方向凸出则为寒流”。甲处等温线凸向上方低温区，因此甲处受暖流影响。
